name: Festival São Pedro at WOW
description: Cross the bridge to Gaia for one last popular saints party. WOW hosts a São Pedro festival with typical food stalls, live music, and unbeatable views of Porto.
longDescription:
The Festival São Pedro at WOW is a large-scale, annual celebration of the popular saint, hosted by the World of Wine cultural district in Gaia. This festival marks the final major popular saints' festivity in the Porto region, offering a dedicated event for locals and visitors to enjoy traditional Portuguese culture. The event focuses on culinary traditions and live entertainment, characteristic of the São Pedro celebrations.

Visitors to the Festival São Pedro can expect an outdoor festival atmosphere with a focus on gastronomy. The event features numerous food stalls offering typical Portuguese dishes associated with popular saints' festivals. Live music performances will be ongoing throughout the day. The World of Wine complex provides an expansive setting with views across the Douro River towards Porto. The festival is designed to be family-friendly, catering to a broad audience.

Entry to the Festival São Pedro is free. The World of Wine complex is located in Gaia, accessible by crossing the Luís I Bridge from Porto. From the Porto side, it is a walk across the bridge. Alternatively, local buses serve the Gaia riverside area. The venue is generally accessible.
